change: The content kind, for a private repository of authored content (documents, data) that pubkit neither releases nor deploys: init --kind=content writes the common managed files only and needs no --project; its CI runs checks (the managed files in step, and shellcheck on **/*.sh unless with gives shellcheck) and, when with gives a test, tests, which runs its own tooling's checks, with no scan; a release in its ci block stops sync; its protect block's tags defaults to false and refuses tags true and release_app; the nightly governs it like any other repository
